hits.section: Where can I get the tax proof for section 80C?
hits.text:
Groww Help - Where can I get the tax proof for section 80C? — Where can I get the tax proof for section 80C?
You can request your tax proof for Section 80C by downloading the Mutual Fund-ELSS statement.
Steps to request your ELSS Statement:
Go to your profile.
Select the 'Reports' option.
Under 'Tax', find 'Mutual Fund - Capital Gains'.
Choose the financial year and click 'Download'.
Click the button below to go directly to the 'Reports' section.

hits.section: What is a mutual funds ELSS report?
hits.text:
Groww Help - What is a mutual funds ELSS report? — What is a mutual funds ELSS report?
The ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) report shows your purchases in ELSS mutual funds and the total amount you invested in the selected financial year.
Here's how you can download it:
Go to your profile.
Select the 'Reports' option.
Under 'Tax', find 'Mutual Fund - ELSS statement'.
Click on 'Download'.
Note: The password to open the report is your PAN number in capital letters.
